Database: cre_Doc_Tracking_DB
Schema:
  documents_to_be_destroyed(Document_ID, Destruction_Authorised_by_Employee_ID, Destroyed_by_Employee_ID, Planned_Destruction_Date, Actual_Destruction_Date, Other_Details)
  employees(Employee_ID, Role_Code, Employee_Name, Gender_MFU, Date_of_Birth, Other_Details)

  projects(Project_ID, Project_Details)
  documents(Document_ID, Document_Type_Code, Project_ID, Document_Date, Document_Name, Document_Description, Other_Details)
SQL:
  SELECT T1.project_id , T1.project_details FROM Projects AS T1 JOIN Documents AS T2 ON T1.project_id = T2.project_id GROUP BY T1.project_id HAVING count(*) > 2

Database: cre_Docs_and_Epenses
Schema:
  documents(Document_ID, Document_Type_Code, Project_ID, Document_Date, Document_Name, Document_Description, Other_Details)
  documents_with_expenses(Document_ID, Budget_Type_Code, Document_Details)
SQL:
  SELECT T1.document_date FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS T2 ON T1.document_id = T2.document_id WHERE T2.budget_type_code = 'GV' INTERSECT SELECT T1.document_date FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS T2 ON T1.document_id = T2.document_id WHERE T2.budget_type_code = 'SF'
